scope: Core cast-exclusive and obtainable skill reconciliation

records.name: Giant Storm
records.character_source: Nappa; Raditz, Broly, Bardock, Omega Shenron, Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed), and Kefla (Super Saiyan) Customize Partners
records.effect: Creates a large tracked explosion beneath the opponent.

records.name: Gigantic Slam
records.character_source: Broly; Broly (Supervillain); Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan) Customize Partner

records.name: Pretty Charge
records.effect: Ki charging Super that functions similarly to Full Power Charge and ends with Ribrianne's pose.

records.name: Darkness Mixer
records.effect: Charge Super that rapidly restores Ki and Stamina while its dark aura damages nearby enemies and blocks normal Ki shots.

notes: Both identities are explicitly documented in current Xenoverse 2 skill-category pages. Giant Storm is an obtainable Ki Blast Ultimate with a 300 Ki cost and Skill Shop unlock. Gigantic Slam is a 100 Ki Strike Super and explicitly unavailable to CaCs. These were absent from docs/data/skills.json at research time. Pretty Charge and Darkness Mixer were also absent from canonical skills.json and are now reconciled here. Surging Spirit was checked but is already present canonically, so it was not duplicated.
